name: eLocal

sources.title: Business sign-up — 'Join Our Marketplace' pay-per-call lead program; form asks type + name of business

requirements: NOT a free citation directory — eLocal is a pay-per-call lead-generation marketplace ('pay for performance' phone leads)
Fit: local service businesses (pest control, roofing, legal, HVAC — their testimonials) wanting inbound phone calls/form leads
Sign-up form starts with 'Type of Business' and 'Name of Business' (2-step flow)
Account login exists at /business_users/login; advertiser terms at /information#advertiser_terms
preparation: Service area and hours (they credit calls outside your hours/area)
Budget for per-lead/per-call charges — pricing not shown on the page
workflow: Open https://elocal.com/sign-up and complete 'Join Our Marketplace' (type of business → business name → contact details)
Configure service area and lead preferences in the dashboard
Pay for qualified calls/form leads as they arrive
watchFor: Source-claimed 'free directory listing' is wrong — this is paid lead-gen; there is no free listing product visible
Poor fit for a SaaS launch: leads are homeowner/local-service phone calls
Pricing is not published — expect sales contact or per-call rates revealed after signup
BBB accreditation badge shown; advertiser terms live under /information
countsAsLive: Your business account is active in their marketplace and receiving/routing calls or form leads
unknowns: Whether any public-facing profile/backlink exists at all
Minimum spend or contract terms (they claim 'no-commitment')
